reports.title: RESULTS FOR THE SECOND QUARTER FISCAL 2027

lines: Net sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 were $949.9 million, a decrease of 0.1% from the prior year second quarter net sales of $951.3 million and below the range of the second quarter of fiscal 2027 guidance of $955 million to $995 million.

Excluding these highlighted items, adjusted Net earnings per diluted share for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, on a non-GAAP basis, were $3.22, compared to the guidance of $3.15 to $3.25 per diluted share for the second quarter given by the Company on August 12, 2026.
For the third quarter, we expect net sales of $935 million to $975 million and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.05 to $3.15.
